notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
We’ve released a new update focusing on overall optimization. 
[b]1. Optimized Sound Effects[/b]
[b]2. Optimized Safe Mechanism – Interactions with the safe are now smoother and more responsive.
3. Optimized Door Key System – Improved key handling for a more seamless experience.
4. Enhanced Hints – Hints are now clearer and more helpful to guide your progress.[/b]
Thank you for playing and supporting our game!

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content: [p]We’ve released a new update focusing on overall optimization. Animations are now smoother, character status updates more accurately, and levels load faster with better performance. The fuse and key systems have also been improved for more reliable and seamless gameplay.[/p]
